coaching.better: I'm sorry you're feeling that way and I'm glad you said it. I can't promise any outcome, but McKenna will be honest with you about whether Kimberly can help. And is there someone you can talk to if the low feelings stick around?

coaching.issue: He said he was unsure of the time of another appointment tomorrow and she booked noon anyway, then framed rescheduling as fine rather than getting a commitment to show.
coaching.better: Before I lock noon, can you check that appointment now? If something comes up, I'd rather you text McKenna to move it than miss it. Can you promise me that?

adherence.coach_note: Solid open and a decent discovery on what he has tried (apps since 2007, about a hundred meetup events). Missed the cost and why-now openings he handed her. His 'willingness and ability' hesitation was parked with 'McKenna can go over it', plus a success-rate claim that overreaches. Two specific times offered and the closer text sent live, but he has an unverified conflict tomorrow and no invite acceptance.

flags.summary: Setter cites an 'amazing success rate' and says 'we know that our system works', then says she believes there is somebody out there for everyone, to a prospect who has never dated and is doubting his ability to invest. Implies a relationship outcome; no data or caveat given.
evidence: I, Kimberly, she has an amazing success rate.
So, you know, we know that our system works.
I truly believe there's somebody out there for everyone.
